scope: Scoped native background push-to-talk ownership for guild, accepted P2P and admitted group calls
status: Implemented and automated checks verified; physical Windows acceptance remains open
behavior: Main process issues sender-owned UUID leases with bounded source/kind/key and guild > accepted P2P > group priority. Only trusted top-level renderer IPC may acquire/release; navigation, process loss and destruction retire its exact ownership.
Per-lease signals use a separate IPC channel and exact unsubscribe. Legacy listener cleanup and stale lease release cannot erase another owner.

Native PTT is latched per physical press; ownership transfer emits synthetic up. A known held old binding remains a release barrier across unbind and replacement; a new bound key pressed during that barrier also must release before speaking. Only bound key state is retained, never arbitrary event/key history or keycode logs.

Renderer bridge fences auth/source/current call, returns late acquired leases after retirement, silences focused text/composition, and keeps native background hold through blur/hidden visibility. Browser foreground guards remain.

Guild encrypted admission closure, group key/session closure, private call failure/auth/disposal and shortcut capture retire native leases. Registration failure is observable with explicit recovery; stale guild Retry cannot affect a later source/account/channel.
Initial/recovered private PTT output remains disabled until an admitted current lease press; manual mute/deafen and original capture/publisher guards remain authoritative.
